standard_prerequisites.name: The left Kan extension as a colimit over a category of morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the description of the left Kan extension as a colimit indexed by morphisms from the object into the images of objects
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the nonemptiness of a value into the existence of a morphism into the image of an object.

core_obligations: Exactness (proof lines 3111-3113): the pullback, being part of a morphism of sites, is exact and therefore preserves the final object.

The covering (proof lines 3114-3118): the pullback of the final object is the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the final presheaf, so there is a covering on whose members that left Kan extension has a section; since its value is a colimit indexed by morphisms from the object into the images of objects of the source category, nonemptiness provides such a morphism.
proof_roadmap: Use exactness to see that the pullback of the final object is the final object.
Pass to the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the final presheaf to get a covering with nonempty values.
Read off the required morphisms from the description of the left Kan extension as a colimit.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of sites every object of the source site admits a covering whose members map into the image of an object of the target site (statement lines 3101-3108). The proof is a short but complete argument: exactness of the pullback shows that the pullback of the final object is the final object (proof lines 3111-3113); the pullback is the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the final presheaf, so there is a covering on whose members that left Kan extension has a section (proof lines 3114-3115); and since its values are colimits indexed by morphisms from the object into images of objects, such a morphism exists (proof lines 3116-3118). The non-formal content is the passage from a section of a colimit to one of its terms. The claim is H1: a short argument with each input named.
